# Grossman Attorneys at Law

> National law firm specializing in Defense Base Act claims, maritime and admiralty injury litigation, and serious personal injury compensation for civilian contractors and maritime workers.

Grossman Attorneys at Law represents injured civilian contractors, seamen, longshoremen, and maritime workers across the United States with offices in Florida and Washington, DC. The firm focuses on Defense Base Act claims for overseas contractor injuries, Jones Act seaman claims, LHWCA longshore worker claims, and maritime accident litigation.

## Key Topics

- Defense Base Act (DBA)
- Jones Act
- Maritime and Admiralty Law
- Longshore and Harbor Workers' Compensation Act (LHWCA)
- Civilian Contractor Injuries
- PTSD Claims
- Burn Pit Exposure
- Seaman Injury Claims
- Overseas Contractors
- Workers' Compensation
- Injury Claims
- Wrongful Death
- No Win No Fee
- U.S. Department of Labor
- Howard Grossman

## Defense Base Act Claims

- [National Defense Base Act Lawyers | DBA Claim Law Firm](https://grossmanattorneys.com/defense-base-act-claim-law-firm): Defense Base Act claims representation for civilian contractors injured overseas.
- [How to File a DBA Claim](https://grossmanattorneys.com/how-to-file-a-dba-claim): Step-by-step guide to filing Defense Base Act claims with legal assistance.
- [Defense Base Act Forms](https://grossmanattorneys.com/defense-base-act-forms): Department of Labor DBA forms (LS-201, OWCP-5a) for injury claim filing.
- [PTSD Claims for Federal Contractors](https://grossmanattorneys.com/federal-contractor-ptsd-claims): PTSD disability claims for federal contractors under Defense Base Act.
- [Burn Pit Exposure Compensation Lawyer](https://grossmanattorneys.com/burn-pit-exposure-lawsuit): Burn pit exposure compensation claims for civilian contractors in Iraq/Afghanistan.
- [Defense Base Act Settlement Calculator](https://grossmanattorneys.com/defense-base-act-settlement-calculator): Tool for calculating potential Defense Base Act settlement compensation.

## Maritime and Admiralty Law

- [National Admiralty & Maritime Injury Lawyers](https://grossmanattorneys.com/national-admiralty-maritime-injury-attorneys): Maritime and admiralty injury representation for seamen and maritime workers.
- [National Jones Act Injury Lawyers](https://grossmanattorneys.com/national-jones-act-injury-claim-attorneys): Jones Act seaman injury claims and maritime worker compensation representation.
- [National Longshore Accident Lawyers](https://grossmanattorneys.com/national-longshoreman-injury-attorneys): Longshore and Harbor Workers' Compensation Act claims for injured maritime workers.
